Ellsworth Farmers Exchange serving all of Northern Michigan
For over a century, providing everything a farmer needs to turn seat and soil into bounty.
Whether you’re a farmer, rancher, forester, gardener, landowner or homeowner, Ellsworth Farmers Exchange has the supplies you need. Our agricultural store proudly serves Alanson, Mancelona, Atwood and Ellsworth, MI and surrounding areas.
Our crew can deliver your supplies or get them ready for you to pick up. Contact us today to place an order.

Best Fertilizer Supplier in Northern Michigan
Over the years, EFE has continuously added to its many services, making it a one-stop shop for farmers, ranchers, foresters, gardeners, landowners, homeowners, drivers, pet and bird lovers – in other words, there is something for everyone. Those products and services include a full line of feeds, fertilizers, agronomy, crop seeds, tires, batteries and farm supplies.
Ellsworth Energy Services, LLC offers complete LP gas and refined fuel distribution with deliveries to homes, farms, commercial sites and a driver on-call for weekend and night-time emergencies as well as operating the on-site gas station in downtown Ellsworth featuring no-lead and ethanol free gasoline, on-road premium diesel fuel, off-road premium diesel and kerosene, and propane cylinder fills.
Experience true small-town service
Our company offers a wide variety of supplies and services. You can count on us when you need:
Farm supplies
Including animal feed, fertilizer, batteries, automotive supplies and crop seed
Fuel
Including no-lead and ethanol-free gasoline, on-road premium diesel, off-road premium diesel, kerosene and propane cylinder fills
Tire services
Including repairs and replacements
Lawn services
Including grading, drying and soil analysis
If you need custom feed or general feed for your livestock, we can help. Get in touch with a member of our team to learn more about our services and goods.
Serving the needs of local farmers since 1918
There’s a reason we’re the go-to agricultural store in the area. You’ll appreciate that:
Our team has over 50 years of combined experience
Our company is dedicated to supplying local farmers with whatever they need
We're farmer-owned and have multiple locations to serve you
Call us now at 877-885-0095 or 231-588-2300 to speak with an experienced supplier.
